name: Philippians
overview: The book of Philippians, written by Paul and Timotheus to the believers in Philippi, emphasizes a Christ-centered life marked by steadfast faith and unity. Paul expresses confidence that God will complete the good work begun in believers until the day of Jesus Christ, encouraging them to live in a manner worthy of the gospel. The apostle highlights the surpassing value of knowing Christ, stating that to live is Christ and to die is gain, revealing a deep desire to be with Christ. Additionally, believers are called to exhibit the fellowship, comfort, and mercy found in Christ, striving together with one mind for the faith of the gospel.
